scenario: Paced sustained publication waves with two production Feed fanout workers sharing MySQL
measurement_type: bounded 30-second sustained-write and post-write drain acceptance; one host

consistency_checks: all videos received exactly 320 unique inbox rows
worker attempts matched three 128-row batches plus one terminal empty batch per video
all 120 fixture videos were returned exactly once across three Following Feed cursor pages
the first 50 Following Feed entries had a continuation cursor

limitations: Both API processes and MySQL/Redis ran on one WSL2 host.
The write window was about 30 seconds and used one author with 320 followers.
This verifies a bounded workload and a 60-second drain deadline; it does not establish multi-host capacity, longer-duration throughput, or behavior at larger follower counts.
